name: FALL (Tuning: “Sabat: The Tree + Modulations”)
description: FALL moves through a progression of chord changes built over a descending bass line. These outline the 81 microchromatic steps of the overtonal pitch set used in Marc Sabat's cycle "The Tree" (2023-), which is limited to odd partial pitch classes up to 255 and a prime limit 47, allowing every note to be part of at least a 3-note harmonic chord. The descent begins on D4, falling enharmonically to G3, jumps up an octave to G4, then descends enharmonically to end on C4.
